class M(type):
 def __matmul__(cls,other): return [other]
 def __rmatmul__(cls,other): return [other+1]
 def __imatmul__(cls,other): return [other+2]
class C(metaclass=M): pass
print((C@7)[0],(7@C)[0])
x=C
x @=7
print(x[0])

class Mod: pass
m=Mod()
class A:
 def __pow__(self,other,mod):
  print(other,mod is m)
  return mod
print(pow(A(),7,m) is m)

class Mod: pass
m=Mod()
class A:
 def __rpow__(self,other,mod):
  print(other,mod is m)
  return [mod]
print(pow(7,A(),m)[0] is m)

class M(type):
 def __pow__(cls,other,mod): return [other,mod]
 def __rpow__(cls,other,mod): return [mod,other]
class C(metaclass=M): pass
m=[]
print(pow(C,7,m)[1] is m,pow(7,C,m)[0] is m)
